description: Per-runner mount rules, default settings, and model-discovery metadata are still duplicated across agent_defaults.py and launcher/mounts.py instead of being driven from RunnerSpec in runners/.
goal: Extend RunnerSpec in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/spec.py and the runner definitions in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/antigravity.py, runners/claude.py, runners/codex.py, runners/opencode.py, runners/pi.py, and runners/__init__.py so each runner's mounts, defaults, and model-discovery hook metadata live on RunnerSpec as the single source of truth. Refactor apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_defaults.py and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/launcher/mounts.py to derive per-runner defaults, mounts, and model-discovery hooks from RUNNER_SPECS / runner_spec_for() without duplicating per-runner tables or hardcoded agent-id if/elif branches. Keep runners/ strictly acyclic (never import agent_defaults, agent_runner, or launcher.mounts from runners/ so test_import_cycle_ratchet.py stays green without expanding any cycle). Keep every modified module strictly within its existing line budget (never touch holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json), and keep all existing public symbols and test behavior intact. Add focused tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_runner_specs.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_agent_defaults.py proving that runner mounts, defaults, and model-discovery hooks read from RunnerSpec with no duplicated per-runner tables in agent_defaults.py. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Making RunnerSpec the single source of truth for mounts, defaults, and model-discovery hooks removes cross-file per-runner duplication and simplifies adding or updating runners.
acceptance_criteria: Runner mounts, defaults, and model-discovery hooks read from `RunnerSpec` without duplicating per-runner tables in `agent_defaults.py`.

Focused unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_runner_specs.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_agent_defaults.py verify RunnerSpec-driven mounts, defaults, and model-discovery hooks without adding any import cycle (`uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint` pass).

All changes remain within apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/spec.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/__init__.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/antigravity.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/claude.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/codex.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/opencode.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/pi.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_defaults.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/launcher/mounts.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_agent_defaults.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_runner_specs.py (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched), and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
